name: Campingplatz Jugendherberge Possenhofen
beschreibung: The campsite and youth hostel Campingplatz Jugendherberge Possenhofen is situated in a tranquil alpine setting, providing an affordable and welcoming hub for active travellers. The surrounding mountains, forests, and bathing lakes are ideal for hiking and cycling. Combining outdoor pitches for motorhomes and tents with functional shared hostel rooms, the facility features a communal lounge and a self-catering guest kitchen in an easygoing, budget-friendly atmosphere.
